title: Guardrail Catalog Entry
description: One publish-time guardrail rule, consumed by this repository's own engine (src/jaas_guardrails/engine.py).

id.description: Stable identifier. Never reused for a different meaning once shipped.

mandatory.description: Must be true only for level 1 entries. Mandatory checks are force-enabled by the engine regardless of tenant policy.

default_enabled.description: Whether a tenant with no explicit policy runs this check (ignored for mandatory entries, which are always on).

standard_ref.description: Short citation of the industry standard/tool this rule is derived from.

kind.description: Names the executor in src/jaas_guardrails/executors.py that knows how to run this rule's config.

config.description: Executor-specific configuration. Shape depends on `kind`; see README.md for the schema of each kind.
